features.name: Datapad baseline
features.note: Live Datapad build: scene sequencer, combat composer, end turn, GM options, initiative tracker, dice settings, paged history.

features.name: Turn Builder 4
features.note: Custom box in every combat category, Secondary activity (not an extra action), deterministic suggestions with an optional play style.

features.name: Taunt (bonus action)
features.note: Owner-ratified contested check: Charisma (Intimidation or Deception) vs Wisdom (Insight); on a win the target has disadvantage against anyone but Aero until his next turn. No forced attack.

features.name: WHISPER context
features.note: Optional private feelings, what Aero shows, motive, reflection and What-if prompts. Blank = not stated. No effect on morality.

features.name: Evidence, memory/appraisal, causal proposals
features.note: Pure evaluators on noncanonical fixtures; see the diagnostics page. Not wired into play.

features.name: WHISPER after-turn review
features.note: Suggestions with evidence after a consequential turn; Accept / Edit / Reject / Later / your own words. Preview shows a sample review.

unavailable: GM turns, dice and narration (no GM attached)
Hask Meadow and any live data
